decision: The competitor (Alfa Romeo F1 Team ORLEN) is fined €1,000.
event_name: Date 13 November 2022 Time 18:40 2022 BRAZILIAN GRAND PRIX 10 - 13 November 2022 The Stewards Title Offence - Alfa Romeo Team Personnel in Pit Lane Description Offence - Alfa Romeo Team Personnel in Pit Lane
fact: Team Personnel in an unsafe location in pit lane.
offence: Breach of Article 12.2.1.h of the FIA International Sporting Code
reason: The Stewards heard from the team representative. The Stewards reviewed the video from several angles. A member of the Alfa Romeo team who is not involved in pit stops entered the pit lane working area and was in a position where he was unreasonably close to the path of the approaching Haas car which was starting its pit stop. The Stewards determined that this was an unsafe situation.
stewards: Date 13 November 2022 Alfa Romeo F1 Team ORLEN Time 18:40 The Stewards
having received a report from the Race Director
in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Alfa Romeo Team Personnel In Pit Lane
